bullets.text: Starlink Spectrum Boost - **Ofcom** grants **Starlink** E band spectrum for enhanced backhaul capacity in the UK.
Verizon Acquires Starry - **Verizon** acquires **Starry Internet** to enhance 5G fixed wireless access capabilities.
Nvidia Backs Nokia - **NVIDIA** invests in **Nokia** to advance AI and 6G capabilities in telecom networks.
5G Core Evolution - The **5G** core is transforming network architecture, enabling programmable and intelligent connectivity.
MTN's StarEdge Horizon - **MTN** launches **StarEdge Horizon** for enhanced LEO satellite connectivity for enterprises.
AI-Native 6G Networks - **Samsung** explores AI-native **6G** networks to enhance enterprise operations and user experience.
Telecoms Cloud Investment - Telecom operators are increasing cloud spending to automate operations and enhance AI capabilities.
Zayo and Nokia Partnership - **Zayo** partners with **Nokia** to modernize IP network infrastructure for enhanced connectivity.
ZTE Revenue Growth - **ZTE** reports significant revenue growth driven by computing-related businesses and international expansion.
Lynk and Omnispace Merger - **Lynk** and **Omnispace** merge to enhance global satellite direct-to-device connectivity.
